reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire first, consuming the 3 Sparks, then Flame on the Wick and Kaboom! on Seapunk, followed by Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I considered playing Kaboom! first with the Spark discount, then Rapid Fire for 2 energy and Flame on the Wick, but that would leave no energy for Duck and Cover while dealing the same total damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up all 3 Sparks, all 2 energy, and every card in hand; it did not give up damage or available Block compared with the other line considered.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. Given only the printed information, no different intent would improve on playing all three attacks while still gaining the available 5 Block.
